reuse.why: Builds getExpectedScheduleAmount on the existing getRangedScheduleAmount and the existing getApproxNumberThreshold, and makes getScheduledAmount delegate to it.

duplication.why: Removes the four inline missing/number/range ternaries in favour of one helper; only a redundant null check remains in getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules beside the ranged rule, and server callers pass their own op.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its callers, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: The server paths share one definition, but getScheduledAmount's op is a third optional positional argument and the desktop-client callers (Balance, SchedulesTable, mobile lists) were not updated, so approximate amounts are planned differently on the client.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Callers that were changed use the shared helper; the client callers use getScheduledAmount but omit the op rather than bypassing it.

one_place.where: The rule is defined once in shared/schedules getExpectedScheduleAmount, but desktop-client Balance.tsx, SchedulesTable.tsx, SchedulesListItem.tsx and MobileSchedulesPage.tsx still call getScheduledAmount without the op, so those paths do not apply the approximate rule.
